# Vendor attribution

The congressional scrapers in this directory — `scrape_house.py`,
`scrape_senate.py`, and `schema.py` — are adapted from the open-source
**Quantgress** project (congressional trading data pipeline). They were
modified for this project's incremental daily runs and DuckDB storage.

All filing data they collect is U.S. public record (House Clerk and
Senate eFD disclosures).
